observations: Large black multifunction printer wrapped in clear plastic film.
Brand 'KONICA MINOLTA' and model 'bizhub 223' are printed on the front panel in photo 0.
The machine is partially covered by cardboard and plastic wrap.
A white automatic document feeder (ADF) is visible on top in photo 1.
The machine appears to be a standalone unit with a paper tray at the bottom.
No power cables, toner cartridges, or paper are visible.

claims.evidence: Requires functional testing of print, scan, and copy.

risks.risk: The machine may not power on or may have internal mechanical faults.
risks.proof: A video showing the machine powering on and completing a self-test.

risks.risk: The toner cartridges may be empty or the drum may be worn out.
risks.proof: A photo of the toner and drum status screen or a photo of the empty toner slots.
risks.if_unproven: as needing new toner and drum

risks.risk: The paper tray may be damaged or unable to hold paper.
risks.proof: A photo of the paper tray with paper inserted.

risks.risk: The machine may have a high total page count (TPO) indicating heavy use.
risks.proof: A photo of the machine's system status screen showing the total page count.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Video of the machine powering on and printing a test page.
Photo of the toner and drum status screen.
Photo of the machine's system status screen showing the total page count.
response.reason: The model is clearly identified from the photos, so it can be priced at its worst case as a non-functional unit.
